sermon.title: The Holy Spirit is the Spirit of Truth 09/29/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that the Holy Spirit is the Spirit of truth who never lies, stays forever, teaches all things, reminds us, and guides us from foundational to mature doctrine. Anything “the spirit told me” that contradicts the word isn’t from Him. Test the spirits, continue loyally in the apostles’ doctrine, and trust in the name of the Lord.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.
